back: At question time, retrieve relevant passages from your documents, put them in the prompt, and have the model answer from them with citations.
Lost tables, merged columns and repeated footers poison every chunk; no embedding model recovers text the parser dropped.
Small: precise vectors, lose context (rules lose exceptions). Large: keep context, blur topics, eat the token budget. Measure hit rate at 2–3 sizes.
Repeat the end of one chunk at the start of the next (e.g. 50–100 tokens) so boundary sentences survive whole. Costs storage, creates near-duplicates.

front: Chunks for 4,000-token docs at 512 tokens, 64 overlap?
Where does access control go in RAG?
back: In the retrieval filter on each chunk's ACL. Text that reaches the prompt can appear in the answer.
BM25 catches exact tokens (codes, SKUs, names, acronyms); vectors catch paraphrases. Each fails where the other succeeds.
Score = Σ 1 / (k + rank) over the result lists, k = 60. Uses ranks, so incompatible score scales don't matter.
Bi-encoder embeds query and chunk separately (indexable, fast). Cross-encoder reads them together (more accurate, too slow for the whole corpus).
Fetch 50–100 candidates cheaply with hybrid search, score them with a reranker, send the top 5–10 to the prompt.
Liu et al. (2023): models use information at the start and end of a long context more reliably than in the middle. Put the best evidence first.
Check every cited id was in the context, spot-check that the chunk supports the claim, and link the source so a human can check.
Share of evaluation questions whose gold passage reached the final context. It caps answer accuracy, so fix it first.

front: First debugging step for a wrong RAG answer?
back: Read the logged retrieved chunk ids: was the gold passage missing, cut by the budget, or present but misused?

front: Why does a nightly upsert crawl leave a stale index?
back: It only writes pages it finds, so deleted pages' chunks stay forever. Propagate deletes and reconcile ids against the source.
Build a new index in parallel, evaluate on the question set, switch an alias. Never re-embed in place.
